description: Search the openings published by named companies on Lever. `companies` takes company names or Lever site names, and each name is turned into a site name here. A name found on the first spelling costs 3 requests, and one that resists costs up to 9, at one second each. location, team, department and commitment are sent to Lever and need its exact wording. keyword, workplace_type, country, salary and recency are applied here, because Lever accepts none of them as filters. limit applies per company, so a company whose openings fill it may publish more. posted_within_days walks up to 5 pages per company, because Lever pages by title and a recent opening sits anywhere.

commitment.description: A list of a commitment exactly as Lever writes it, one to 20 of them.

items.description: A commitment exactly as Lever writes it.

companies.description: A list of a company name or a Lever site name, one to 25 of them.

items.description: A company name or a Lever site name.

country.description: A list of a two-letter country code, as in FR or US, one to 20 of them.

items.description: A two-letter country code, as in FR or US.

currency.description: A three-letter currency code, as in EUR or USD.

department.description: A list of a department exactly as Lever writes it, one to 20 of them.

items.description: A department exactly as Lever writes it.

keyword.description: Words to look for in the title and the advert.

limit.description: How many openings to read per company.

location.description: A list of a location exactly as Lever writes it, one to 20 of them.

items.description: A location exactly as Lever writes it.

posted_within_days.description: How recent an opening must be.

salary_interval.description: The period salary_min is written in, as Lever writes it, such as per-year-salary or per-hour-wage.

salary_min.description: The lowest upper bound of a salary range to keep.

skip.description: How many openings to step over per company.

team.description: A list of a team exactly as Lever writes it, one to 20 of them.

items.description: A team exactly as Lever writes it.

workplace_type.description: A list of remote, hybrid, onsite or unspecified, one to 4 of them.

name: search_jobs

commitment.description: Absent when the company does not record it.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, null when Lever does not record a country.

department.description: Absent when the company does not record it.

interval.description: The period the amounts belong to, as Lever writes it. Never converted.

salary.description: Null when the company published no salary, which is never the same as zero.

read.description: Openings Lever returned, before the filters applied here.

status.description: A company read, one whose site name was not found, one publishing nothing, and one that failed are four different answers.

total_available.description: Lever publishes no result count, so this is always null.

title: Search openings at named companies
